edges.reason: tx.origin is assigned to the owner state variable in the BNVToken constructor, making ownership spoofable via phishing.
tx.origin receives unlimited allowance on the pair, granting a phished origin unrestricted spending.
msg.sender is compared with owner to gate the delegate function.
delegate forwards control into an arbitrary delegatecall operation.
Parameter a is used as the delegatecall target, allowing arbitrary code control of storage.
Parameter b is used as the delegatecall payload, allowing arbitrary state overwrite.
checkBots performs an external low-level call to botProtection before the guarded body, enabling callback reentry.
_from is forwarded into the checkBots modifier external call.
_to is forwarded into the checkBots modifier external call.
_value is forwarded into the checkBots modifier external call.
_value is subtracted from allowance and balanceOf without SafeMath protection.
allowance mapping is decremented with raw arithmetic in transferFrom.
balanceOf mapping is decremented and incremented with raw arithmetic in transferFrom.
msg.sender determines whether the allowance branch is taken in transferFrom.
transfer delegates all execution to transferFrom.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source address passed to transferFrom.
block.timestamp + 600 is used as a miner-influenceable deadline in list.
The timestamp-derived deadline is passed to the router call in list.
pancakeRouter is the callee of the addLiquidityETH external call.
totalSupply is multiplied by 6 and divided by 100 with raw arithmetic in list.
_toAddresses is ABI-encoded into the unvalidated botProtection call from distribute.
_toAddresses is ABI-encoded into the unvalidated botProtection call from list.
_amounts entries are written directly into the balanceOf mapping, including arbitrary mint-like values.

success flag from the delegatecall is returned by delegate.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only meaningful as the source key of transferFrom state mutations.
_to is only meaningful as the destination key credited by transferFrom.
_value is the operand of the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
_spender is only used to index the allowance mapping written by approve.
a is the externally supplied delegatecall target of the unsafe delegatecall.
b is the externally supplied calldata of the unsafe delegatecall.
_toAddresses is only used inside the distribute loop and botProtection call.
_amounts is only written into balanceOf during the list distribution loop.
_numList is the liquidity operand of the raw arithmetic in list.
_botProtection is the constructor input stored directly into the botProtection state variable.
notABot is a transient local holding the result of the checkBots external call.
success is a transient local holding the delegatecall return value in delegate.
i is only the loop counter of the distribute distribution loop.
